positiveComments:
­ First Impression of the Product
When I first saw the product, I was pleased by the generous size of the container. The brown color of the jar gave it quite a luxurious look.
Upon opening the lid, I noticed an additional silver foil seal covering the pads, which showed how much attention was paid to hygiene.
The lid itself is a snap­on cap rather than a screw­top, which, though a small detail, is surprisingly convenient. It allows for quick and easy access to the pads, even when you're in a hurry.

­ Hygiene and Convenience
Inside the lid, there's a plastic tweezer attached for removing the pads. This is a great feature as it eliminates the need to touch the pads with your hands, making it both hygienic and convenient.
After use, you can store the tweezer back in its designated spot inside the lid. There's a groove where the tweezer fits perfectly, ensuring it stays in place. Even if you shake or turn the container upside down, the tweezer won't fall onto the pads, allowing for easy and hygienic storage.

­ The Pads
The pads are thin with small perforations on the surface. Unlike the common circular shape, these pads are square, which allows them to cover a larger area.
What I liked most about the pads was their excellent adherence and stretchability.
Being thin and sufficiently soaked in essence, they adhere well to the skin. Once applied, they stay in place even when you're moving around, which I found impressive.
As these are lifting pads, I tried stretching them over areas that need lifting, like smile lines and the chin. They adhered well even to curved areas and stretched easily, making them simple to apply where needed.

­ Essence Amount and Fragrance
I was very satisfied with the amount of essence on the pads. It was just right ­ not so little that it felt dry, nor so much that it dripped. This allowed for a comfortably moist feeling during use.
The scent can be described as a subtle herb or cica fragrance. It's not overpowering, so even those sensitive to smells should be able to use it without issues.

­ User Experience
As someone with sensitive skin that often reacts to skincare products, I'm pleased to report that I've had no redness or breakouts while using these pads.
For my dry skin, hydration is crucial, and I was particularly satisfied with how moisturized my skin felt even after removing the pad.

There weren't any significant drawbacks to this product.
Some might find it tricky to remove individual pads with the tweezer at first.
With practice, you'll develop a knack for it ­ try gripping the edge of the pad with the tweezer for easier removal.

As these are lifting pads, many of you will likely stretch them when applying.
Here's a tip: use both hands when applying the stretched pad for better adherence and to prevent it from falling off. Simply sticking it on and then pulling might cause the pad to come off in the direction you're pulling. Try this instead!
For example, if you're applying to smile lines, place the pad on the area and hold that part with one hand. Use your other hand to stretch the pad in the desired direction. This way, you can apply the stretched pad without it falling off.
negativeHeadline: To be honest, I had high hopes...
negativeComments:
To be honest, I had high hopes for this product based on my friend's recommendation, but it fell short of my expectations. First off, the lid is supposed to be sealed, but I couldn't open it no matter how hard I tried! I ended up cutting the inside with a knife. Moving on from that, I noticed the pads have large holes in them. These aren't small perforations, but big holes that seem to prevent the pads from holding much essence. They also don't adhere well to the face or neck. My friend suggested using them on neck wrinkles, so I tried stretching one and applying it, but it kept falling off unless I was lying down, which was inconvenient. After removing it, my neck felt so sticky that I had to wash it off with water.

The product feels excessively sticky. The pads have too many holes, making them difficult to keep in place on the face. They don't seem to hold much essence either.

It's probably better to use retinol in a serum or cream form. The same goes for collagen ­ a cream might be more effective.

reviews.headline: Soft skin but the wipes are just awful
reviews.comment: The wipes are a soaking, soggy bog of mess. They are minuscule, and it takes a a minimum of 4 of them to clean your face. The plastic tweezers provided to fish them out of the bog are ridiculous, and the tweezers are hard to store on their little clamp. There are things the manufacturer could learn from the baby wipes ecosphere.

reviews.headline: Huge difference since using these
reviews.comment: I've been using these pads as a mask every other night. I've noticed a huge difference in my skin texture. I've always had texture on one cheek and since using these the texture is gone. I've also noticed a brighter skin and I would say it has help my oily t zone a lot. I want to say that it looks like my pores are getting smaller too. I will be restocking these forever.

reviews.headline: Ok so far
reviews.comment: The pads are really thin but they do work well. I have only been using for a week but so far so good

reviews.headline: Great product
reviews.comment: I started using these pads as mini face masks a few weeks ago and have noticed my skin looks more glowy and even. The fine lines under my eyes are also less noticable. I hope these are never discontinued.
